RECHECK_RESERVED_DRAFT.precondition: draft shape or original article time is invalid

INSPECT_EXECUTION.required_evidence: Assigned GitHub runId, runAttempt, headSha; complete bounded job page; external Publisher remains a distinct interface
INSPECT_EXECUTION.verify: Compare exact assigned run/attempt/commit; incomplete job page or contradiction remains HOLD
INSPECT_EXECUTION.escalate: EIC requests missing original executor receipt

RECHECK_PUBLICATION.required_evidence: current Live, Desk, publisher and public probe receipts
RECHECK_PUBLICATION.verify: EIC review then independent CTO evidence
RECHECK_PUBLICATION.escalate: EIC verifies material and obtains independent CTO sample

RECONCILE_SCHEDULED_OUTCOME.precondition: known original Scheduled Publisher has missing, failed or unbound execution evidence
RECONCILE_SCHEDULED_OUTCOME.required_evidence: original task ID; explicit evidence provenance; original execution and GitHub receipts if available
RECONCILE_SCHEDULED_OUTCOME.expected: separate enablement, run, commit and publication states; HOLD pending independent verification
RECONCILE_SCHEDULED_OUTCOME.verify: no safety-block retry; no enablement-to-success promotion; task/branch binding
RECONCILE_SCHEDULED_OUTCOME.escalate: EIC obtains official task receipt; safety-blocked write requires original safety review, never alternate channel

INSPECT_PUBLICATION_CONTRACT.precondition: scheduled Live schema or checkpoint mismatch
INSPECT_PUBLICATION_CONTRACT.required_evidence: Exact committed Live and Rolling Desk, EIC dispatch receipt, and Pages result
INSPECT_PUBLICATION_CONTRACT.expected: field or gate error bound to the existing incident
INSPECT_PUBLICATION_CONTRACT.verify: validate same commit and deployment, followed by EIC and CTO review
INSPECT_PUBLICATION_CONTRACT.escalate: EIC returns the specified field or checkpoint to the existing Publisher and merge workflow

dispatch: existing protected main EIC workflow, inline public-probe capability only
interrupted_execution: Persist explicit HOLD; resume prior evidence binding and budgets; never promote retained prior result to current success
